# SK7090 — A thrown `NotImplementedException` has no issue reference

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

A member's body is `throw new NotImplementedException()` and nothing names the issue that owes the implementation.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Maintainability |
| Default severity | warning |
| Scope | Semantic |
| Needs a compilation | yes |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 1.3 |
| Supersedes | S3717 |

## Why

⚠ This is `SK7040`'s requirement on the form that compiles, and it sits on Skala's premise rather than beside it. A model asked for an implementation produces a signature with a `throw new NotImplementedException()` body far more readily than it says it cannot do the work — and that body type-checks, binds, formats, and passes every analyzer in the build. It fails only when it runs, in a caller that had no way to know. A `TODO` at least announces itself to whoever opens the line; this announces itself to nobody. The requirement is therefore the same one `SK7040` makes: somewhere a reader will already be looking, name the issue that owns finishing this. The same vocabulary is accepted — a URL, `#123`, or a project key such as `SKALA-123` — read from the exception's own message, from the throw's own comments, or from the enclosing member's leading trivia.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
public decimal Total(Order order) => throw new NotImplementedException();
```

Write:

```csharp
// TODO SKALA-412: the discount table is not specified yet.
public decimal Total(Order order) => throw new NotImplementedException("SKALA-412");
```

## When it does not fire

⚠ Report-only, and deliberately so: no edit writes the implementation, and every mechanical guess available — delete the member, return `default`, change the exception type — turns a loud failure into a quiet one, which is strictly worse than what is there. Only a construction that is *thrown* is reported; Sonar's `S3717` tracks every use of the type, but constructing one to compare against or to hand to a test helper is not a member that compiles and does not work. ⚠ **`NotSupportedException` and `UnreachableException` never fire, and that is the rule's position rather than an omission.** Both are permanent statements about a contract — an operation this type will never offer, a branch the author asserts is unreachable — and they are what an author writes when the answer really is "not here". `NotImplementedException` is the one that means "not yet", and "not yet" is what needs an owner. A repository that uses source comments as its backlog should disable the rule, exactly as it would `SK7040`. Generated code is excluded.

## Configuration

- `dotnet_diagnostic.SK7090.severity`
